description: The SERVICES table contains information on patient transfers between different hospital services during their admissions. It tracks the patient's previous and current service assignments, along with the date and time of the transfer, linking patients (SUBJECT_ID) and hospital admissions (HADM_ID) to specific service transitions.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Identifier for each patient receiving a service.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Identifier for each hospital admission during which a service was provided.

columns.name: TRANSFERTIME
columns.description: Date and time when the patient's service was transferred.

columns.name: PREV_SERVICE
columns.description: The service the patient was on prior to the current transfer (e.g., VSURG, NSURG, CMED).

columns.name: CURR_SERVICE
columns.description: The service the patient is currently on (e.g., ORTHO, OBS, NMED).
